content.title: Reach the sales contact page from a homepage Contact sales control
content.intent: Prove that the anonymous visitor can use a visible homepage Contact sales control to open the sales contact page and reach the rendered sales form.
content.technique_notes: Applied the Web form profile because the journey ends on a public data-entry form and the source limits coverage to render and validation without submission. Applied equivalence partitioning to treat visible homepage Contact sales controls as one successful-navigation family because the required outcome is unchanged by control location. Negative, boundary-value, and covering-array techniques were not applied here because this path proves navigation and rendered form presence rather than constrained input combinations.
